_comment: External metabolic pathway and enzyme resources linked from /metabolic_pathways.
This file is the single source for the resource sections, the metric cards and
the client search index, in the same way data/ai/ai_resources.json drives /ai.
Add a resource here and it appears in all three places at once.
Every URL is the one the host actually serves after redirects, not the older
address it still honours: http://www.chem.qmul.ac.uk/iubmb/enzyme/ answers 301
301 to https://enzyme.expasy.org/. Recording the destination saves every reader
a redirect and keeps the link working when the old host is eventually retired.
'group' selects the section. 'maize' marks a resource that is specific to Zea
mays rather than a general reference, which is what the first metric counts.

groups.title: Maize pathway databases
groups.lead: Pathway databases that carry a maize organism build.

groups.title: Pathway and reaction databases
groups.lead: General pathway resources that maize pathways are built from and compared against.

groups.title: Enzyme nomenclature and kinetics
groups.lead: The reference works behind the EC numbers and enzyme names used above.

resources.name: CornCyc at the Plant Metabolic Network
resources.description: The maintained CornCyc build: maize metabolic pathways, enzymes and reactions predicted with the E2P2 pipeline and curated by PMN. This is the resource that replaced the CornCyc instances MaizeGDB used to host.

resources.name: Plant Reactome
resources.description: Curated and orthology-projected plant pathways, including Zea mays, with pathway diagrams, comparative analysis across species and expression overlays.

resources.name: KEGG maize pathway maps
resources.provider: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes
resources.description: The KEGG pathway maps built for Zea mays (organism code zma), each linking to the maize genes assigned to it.

resources.name: Reactome
resources.description: Open, peer-reviewed pathway database covering reactions, complexes and regulatory events, and the framework Plant Reactome is built on.

resources.name: BioCyc
resources.description: The Pathway/Genome Database collection that CornCyc, MetaCyc and PlantCyc belong to, with the Pathway Tools software behind them.

resources.name: Plant Metabolic Network
resources.description: PlantCyc and the family of species databases, including CornCyc, with the release notes and pipeline documentation for each build.

resources.name: KEGG pathway database
resources.provider: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes
resources.description: The reference pathway maps for metabolism, genetic and environmental information processing, and disease, from which the per-organism maps are drawn.

resources.name: IUBMB Enzyme Nomenclature
resources.provider: International Union of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
resources.description: The authoritative list of EC numbers, accepted enzyme names, reactions and systematic names, maintained by the IUBMB nomenclature committee.

resources.name: BRENDA
resources.description: Enzyme functional data collected from the literature: kinetic parameters, substrates and products, inhibitors, stability and organism-specific measurements.

resources.name: ENZYME at Expasy
resources.description: A nomenclature repository keyed on EC number, cross-referenced to UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot entries for the proteins that carry each activity.
